item.text: I’m checking the reconstructed filing JSON for the cover page stock count, then I’ll extract the shortest document-backed value and return it exactly as requested.
I found the filing text with share counts, but I still need the exact cover-page outstanding common stock line rather than a later note/table. I’m searching the cover page wording now.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "jq -r '.texts[] | select((.text // \"\") | test(\"shares of common stock outstanding as of\"; \"i\")) | \"page \\(.page_no): \\(.text)\"' /mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/AMCOR_2019_10K_reconstructed.json"
